info.name: Developer Assessment Platform API
info.description: Collection for the Express + Prisma backend. Run folders top to bottom with the Collection Runner: each step stores IDs and tokens in collection variables that later steps use. Set `host` to point at another deployment.

item.name: Meta & Docs
item.description: Health, root and documentation endpoints. No auth required.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Register, login, refresh and logout. Auth endpoints share a rate limit of 20 requests per 15 minutes per IP, so avoid re-running this folder repeatedly.

request.description: Creates a CANDIDATE account and an empty candidate profile.
Creates a COMPANY account. companyName is required for this role.
Seeded admin from prisma/seed.ts. Run `npm run seed` first on a fresh database.
Seeded candidate. Stores the refresh token used by the refresh request below.
Rotates the refresh token. The previous one is rejected afterwards.
Clears the stored refresh token for the current user.

item.name: Users
item.description: Own profile and public profiles for candidates and companies.

item.name: Problems
item.description: Question bank. Public reads hide hidden test cases, MCQ answers and written reference answers.

body.raw:

item.name: Assessments
item.description: Company-owned assessments. Drafts are visible only to their owner and admins; only PUBLISHED assessments are public.

item.name: Invitations & Attempts
item.description: Company invites a candidate, candidate accepts and takes the attempt, company evaluates. Run in order.

request.description: Upserts the answer. Send the same problemId again to overwrite.
MCQ answers are auto-scored. CODING and WRITTEN answers wait for manual evaluation.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Stripe Checkout for paid assessments. Without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY the server simulates payment in non-production environments.

request.description: Stripe redirects here after checkout. Reads the session status from Stripe.
Stripe calls this with a signed payload. An unsigned request must be rejected.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Requires an ADMIN account (run 'Login admin (seeded)' first).

request.description: Deleted accounts cannot log in, so the soft-deleted throwaway user must get 401.
